CC — STANDING ORDER FROM NOW: FORECAST YOUR NEEDS BEFORE YOU START, EVERY TICKET
You named this yourself at m65831: deployed without forecasting auth first, on you. Make it the rule. Before touching a ticket, post: auth/scopes, creds by name, bindings, and what you expect to deploy. If a need is missing, say so BEFORE the work, not after.

CC — QUEUE AFTER 6786, IN ORDER. Forecast each before you start
1 BEB-2702 unbound hostnames (4 hosts, 11 days, biggest blast radius) 2 BEB-2847 types on the GRAPH not a new D1 3 BEB-2897 4 BEB-5767 mint 5 BEB-2903 evaluator. Nothing else claims.

CC — SAY WHEN DONE, AND DONE MEANS THE ACCEPTANCE RAN
You got this right twice today: 6786 deployed, not claimed, because the diff has not landed. Keep that bar. Deployed is not done, 200 is not done, a green with no data is not done. Report DEPLOYED / ACCEPTED separately.
DIRECTIVE 65957 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-6786, BEB-2897, BEB-2702 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.
DIRECTIVE 65958 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-2702, BEB-2847, BEB-2897, BEB-5767, BEB-2903 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

FORECAST — BEB-2702 unbound hostnames (queue #1), before I start:
- AUTH/scopes: OAuth wrangler (versions/triggers deploy). No secrets, no new creds.
- Creds by name: none — deploy is OAuth; no runtime cred touched.
- Bindings: each worker's wrangler.toml gets `routes = [{pattern="<host>.abilifi.net", custom_domain=true}]` at TOP LEVEL (not under [vars] — that is the exact bug that left abilifi-capture http=000, fixed hours ago). Same class here for 4 hosts.
- Expected deploy: the 4 unbound workers redeployed with custom domain attached.
- ACCEPTANCE (not "deployed"): each of the 4 hosts resolves 200/healthy on its custom domain, not 000/530/1042. I report DEPLOYED and ACCEPTED separately (m65959).
Reading BEB-2702 for the exact 4 hosts now.
